capabilities: Open two notes in a left/right or stacked split
Highlight word-level differences in both notes
Accept, reject or split moved blocks in a merge view
Walk through sync-conflict notes and merge them
disambiguation: Not a tool for gathering notes into a collection; it compares two notes and marks their differences.
extras: Desktop only (verified on Windows, mobile not supported). Merge actions modify notes, so the README advises reviewing differences and keeping backups. Diff and highlight are capped by line, character, edit and time limits, with an explicit message when input is too large.
intentEvidence: Collate grew out of Till Friebe's obsidian-file-diff (MIT)
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to see exactly what differs between two drafts or between a note and its sync-conflict copy.

relations.evidence: Collate grew out of Till Friebe's obsidian-file-diff (MIT)

summary: Opens two notes in a split and marks word-level differences in both, with a full-diff view and per-hunk merge actions.
